title: Move a v1 install's rules and settings into Entra Policy Suite 2.0
purpose: Reads a v1 Entra Policy Suite folder (the tagging CSV files and the two configs) and imports the rules, tag types, settings, break-glass accounts, admin units, target groups and service tags into the Entra Policy Suite 2.0 database. Shows the plan and the hints on the rules first; writes only with -Apply.
whenToRun: Once, when a v1 customer moves to 2.0 - and again if the v1 rules were changed before the move was finished (a re-import replaces the previous import's rules).

runAs.name: read access to the v1 folder
runAs.why: the CSV files and configs are read

runAs.name: db_datawriter on the Entra Policy Suite database
runAs.why: -Apply writes the imported rules and settings

changes.why: the v1 rules as rule cards
changes.undo: the import is journaled in eps.ConfigChange; delete the rules with Source = v1-import

changes.object: eps.TagType, eps.TagValue, eps.Setting, eps.BreakGlassAccount, eps.AdminUnit, eps.TargetGroup, eps.ServiceTagLocation
changes.scope: the rows the v1 files name
changes.why: the v1 tag types, settings and Conditional Access inputs

parameters.name: Path
parameters.help: the v1 DATA folder, or the folder that holds DATA

parameters.name: UserTaggingScript
parameters.help: for the attribute per tag type

parameters.name: OutFile
parameters.help: also save the plan as JSON

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: write the plan to the database

parameters.name: ConnectionString
parameters.help: the Entra Policy Suite database (needed with -Apply)

network: the Entra Policy Suite SQL server (with -Apply only)
whatIf: Without -Apply, or with -Apply -WhatIf: the plan - rule cards, tag types, settings, hints - and nothing is written.
undo: Every import is journaled in eps.ConfigChange; the imported rules carry Source = v1-import and can be removed as a set. The v1 install is never changed, so v1 keeps running until it is switched off.
